local me = Game.GetLocalPlayer()
local player = Players[me]
local city = player:GetCities():GetNextRebelledCity()
local source = "rebelled"
if city == nil then
    city = player:GetCities():GetNextCapturedCity()
    source = "captured"
end
if city == nil then print("ERR:NO_PENDING_CITY|No rebelled or captured city pending decision"); print("---END---"); return end
local name = Locale.Lookup(city:GetName())
local pop = city:GetPopulation()
local cid = ((city:GetID() % 65536) + city:GetOwner() * 65536 + 16777216)
local params = {}
params[UnitOperationTypes.PARAM_FLAGS] = CityDestroyDirectives.KEEP
local canDo = CityManager.CanStartCommand(city, CityCommandTypes.DESTROY, params)
if not canDo then print("ERR:CANNOT_KEEP|Cannot keep " .. name .. " (CanStartCommand returned false)"); print("---END---"); return end
CityManager.RequestCommand(city, CityCommandTypes.DESTROY, params)
print("OK:KEEP|" .. name .. " (pop " .. pop .. ", id:" .. cid .. ", " .. source .. ")")
print("---END---")
